newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key 10-yr JGB yield surges after strong tankan.
newsitem.headline: Key 10-yr JGB yield surges after strong tankan.

text.p: The yield of key 182nd 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) rose sharply in early Tokyo on Wednesday after the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) "tankan" corporate sentiment survey showed an unexpectedly strong improvement from the previous survey.
The yield stood at 2.420 percent at 0000 GMT on Wednesday after rising as high as 2.425 percent after the tankan was released at 2350 GMT Tuesday.
The contract closed at 2.340 percent in Tokyo on Tuesday.
The diffusion index for major manufacturers, a key gauge of business confidence, rose to plus seven in June from plus two in March, when the previous survey was conducted.
In March, the survey had forecast a major manufacturers' diffusion index of minus one for June.
